overall.assessment: Prema dostavljenoj strukturi, podcast sadrži stvarne kršćanske poticaje: molitvu, post, pokoru, nadu u vječni život, brigu za pokojne i nerođene te naglasak da vjera mora postati djelotvorna ljubav. Ipak, ponavljano omalovažavanje međureligijskih susreta i političkih protivnika, uz prikazivanje društvenih događaja kao plodova vlastite molitvene kampanje, riskira zamijeniti evanđeosko razlučivanje ideološkom podjelom i neutemeljenim uzročnim tvrdnjama. Evanđelje o posljednjem sudu snažno podsjeća na odgovornost za konkretna djela prema bližnjemu, ali strah od osude ne smije potisnuti milosrđe, nadu i poštovanje dostojanstva svake osobe. Zbog tih ozbiljnih pastoralnih i društvenih rizika, unatoč prisutnim dobrim kršćanskim poticajima, cjelina djeluje djelomično usklađeno, a ne kao pouzdano promicanje kulture susreta.
seeds_of_logos: Molitva, krunica, post i pokora predstavljeni su kao načini obraćenja i oslanjanja na Boga, a ne samo kao vanjski običaji.

Razmatranje posljednjeg suda može podsjetiti da se kršćanska vjera provjerava djelima milosrđa prema gladnima, bolesnima, strancima i drugim ranjivima; to je središnji naglasak Matejeva evanđeoskog prikaza suda.
Briga za pokojne i nerođene, obitelj, majčinstvo, odgovornost te svjedočanstva o odricanju radi obitelji izražavaju poštovanje prema životu i ljudskim odnosima.
Tvrdnja da molitva i post nisu jedina strana kršćanskog djelovanja može otvoriti prostor za odgovornu službu bližnjemu i zauzimanje za opće dobro.
concerns: Ponavljana oštra kritika međureligijskih susreta može poticati nepovjerenje i odbacivanje kulture dijaloga. Katoličko razumijevanje dijaloga ne znači relativizam ni odricanje od Kristove istine: traži poštovanje savjesti i suradnju za mir, siromašne i zajedničko dobro.

Govorenje o ljevici, progresivcima, nacionalistima i konkretnim narodima u tonu duhovnog suprotstavljanja može poistovjetiti evanđelje s političkom stranom te umanjiti dostojanstvo ljudi koji se ne slažu. Društveni nauk usmjerava političko djelovanje prema dostojanstvu osobe, solidarnosti i općem dobru, a ne prema stranačkoj identifikaciji.

Tvrdnje da je post ugasio prosvjede ili da je donio određene političke i društvene ishode prikazane su u sažetku kao uzročne, ali nema podataka kojima bi se takva veza mogla razlučiti. Time se duhovna praksa može instrumentalizirati i Božje djelovanje svesti na potvrđivanje političkih očekivanja.

Svjedočanstva o prestanku nesanice, uzimanju tableta ili polipima zahtijevaju oprez: prema dostavljenoj strukturi nije jasno predstavljaju li se kao osobna iskustva ili kao dokaz da molitva i post zamjenjuju medicinsku skrb. Ne treba zaključivati da podcast to izričito naučava, ali takvo predstavljanje moglo bi slušatelje navesti na neodgovorno tumačenje bolesti i ozdravljenja.

Naglašavanje vječnog ognja i straha Božjega može biti dio ozbiljnog kršćanskog poziva na obraćenje, ali postaje pastoralno neuravnoteženo ako se odvoji od Božjeg milosrđa, nade i poziva na ljubav prema svakom čovjeku.
overall.theological_context: Katolički nauk o posljednjem sudu povezuje vjeru s konkretnim djelima prema bližnjemu, osobito prema ranjivima, a ne s pukim ispovijedanjem religioznih riječi. Gaudium et Spes, kako tasvjetljuje navedeni teološki izvor, poziva na čitanje povijesti u svjetlu Krista, ljudskog dostojanstva i nade, bez utopizma i bez očaja. Socijalni nauk Crkve postavlja dostojanstvo osobe, opće dobro, solidarnost i supsidijarnost kao mjerila društvenog djelovanja, dok crkveno učenje o međureligijskom dijalogu traži otvoreno poštovanje i suradnju, osobito u služenju siromašnima i izgradnji mira.

citations.document_title: How Should Catholic Social Teaching Be Taught to Seminarians?
General Audience of 5 August 2020, Catechesis: “Healing the world” - 1. Introduction

overall.assessment_en: According to the provided structure, the podcast contains genuine Christian encouragements: prayer, fasting, penance, hope in eternal life, care for the deceased and the unborn, and an emphasis that faith must become effective love. Nevertheless, repeated disparagement of interreligious meetings and political opponents, along with presenting social events as the fruits of one's own prayer campaign, risks replacing evangelical discernment with ideological division and unfounded causal claims. The Gospel on the Last Judgment strongly recalls responsibility for concrete deeds toward one's neighbor, but fear of condemnation must not suppress mercy, hope, and respect for the dignity of every person. Due to these serious pastoral and social risks, despite the present good Christian encouragements, the whole appears partially aligned, rather than a reliable promotion of a culture of encounter.
overall.theological_context_en: Catholic teaching on the Last Judgment connects faith with concrete deeds toward one's neighbor, especially toward the vulnerable, rather than with the mere confession of religious words. Gaudium et Spes, as illuminated by the cited theological source, calls for reading history in the light of Christ, human dignity, and hope, without utopianism and without despair. The social teaching of the Church establishes the dignity of the person, the common good, solidarity, and subsidiarity as standards of social action, while ecclesial teaching on interreligious dialogue requires open respect and cooperation, especially in serving the poor and building peace.
seeds_of_logos_en: Prayer, the Rosary, fasting, and penance are presented as ways of conversion and reliance on God, and not merely as external customs.

Contemplation of the Last Judgment can serve as a reminder that Christian faith is tested by works of mercy toward the hungry, the sick, strangers, and other vulnerable persons; this is the central emphasis of Matthew's Gospel account of the judgment.
Care for the deceased and the unborn, family, motherhood, responsibility, and testimonies about renunciation for the sake of family express respect for life and human relationships.
The assertion that prayer and fasting are not the only side of Christian action can open space for responsible service to one's neighbor and engagement for the common good.
concerns_en: Repeated sharp criticism of interreligious meetings can foster distrust and the rejection of a culture of dialogue. The Catholic understanding of dialogue does not mean relativism or the renunciation of Christ's truth: it requires respect for conscience and cooperation for peace, the poor, and the common good.

Speaking about the left, progressives, nationalists, and specific peoples in a tone of spiritual confrontation can equate the Gospel with a political side and diminish the dignity of people who disagree. Social teaching directs political action toward the dignity of the person, solidarity, and the common good, rather than toward partisan identification.

Claims that fasting extinguished protests or that it brought about certain political and social outcomes are presented in the summary as causal, but there are no data by which such a connection could be discerned. Through this, spiritual practice can be instrumentalized and God's action reduced to confirming political expectations.

Testimonies about the cessation of insomnia, taking pills, or polyps require caution: according to the provided structure, it is not clear whether they are presented as personal experiences or as proof that prayer and fasting replace medical care. One should not conclude that the podcast explicitly teaches this, but such a presentation could lead listeners to an irresponsible interpretation of illness and healing.

Emphasizing eternal fire and the fear of God can be part of a serious Christian call to conversion, but it becomes pastorally unbalanced if detached from God's mercy, hope, and the call to love every person.

sections.subtitle: „Dođite, blagoslovljeni Oca mojega”: početak molitvom oslobođenja
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja gledatelje i započinje molitvu oslobođenja i zaštite
sections.content:
Nova epizoda podcasta **Ora et Labora** počinje kratkim pozdravom. Voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** pozdravlja „gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora” i odmah najavljuje evanđelje dana. Njegova je središnja misao Kristov poziv: **„Dođite, blagoslovljeni Oca mojega.”** Ta rečenica obilježava cijelu epizodu, kojoj je naslov *Milosrđe Božje – Oganj vječni i Život vječni?*. Nakon znaka križa slijedi molitva koja u ovom programu uvijek dolazi prva, **molitva oslobođenja i zaštite od zlih sila**.

Grebenar u ime Isusovo „uzima vlast” i veže „sve zle sile i snage” koje nabraja redom: u zraku, na zemlji, u vodi, u podzemlju, na onome svijetu, u prirodi i u vatri. Boga slavi kao „Gospodina nad svim svemirom” i u ime stvorenja mu daje slavu. Zatim veže „sve demonske sile koje su došle protiv nas i naših obitelji”, a sve okupljene stavlja pod zaštitu **dragocjene Kristove krvi** prolivene na križu.

Molitva se potom obraća nebeskim zagovornicima:
- **Mariji**, od koje traži zagovor kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve obitelji i moli je da ih „zaogrne svojim plaštem ljubavi, da se prestraši neprijatelj”;
- **svetom Mihovilu i anđelima čuvarima**, koje poziva da brane obitelji „u borbi protiv svega zla što obilazi svijetom”.

Na kraju dolazi izravna zapovijed silama zla da „odstupe istog časa” od okupljenih, njihovih domova i zemlje. Molitva završava zahvalom Isusu, „jer si vjeran Bog i osjećaš s nama”.

magisterium.assessment: Molitva je uglavnom u skladu s katoličkom pobožnošću: zazivanje Božje pomoći, Kristove otkupiteljske krvi te zagovor Marije, svetog Mihaela i anđela odgovara katoličkoj molitvenoj praksi. Ipak, izraz da molitelj u Isusovo ime „uzima vlast” i veže zle sile može zvučati kao da osobno raspolaže vlašću nad zlodusima, pa bi bilo jasnije molitvu oblikovati kao prošnju Bogu za zaštitu i oslobođenje.
concerns: Formulacija „uzima vlast” i izravno vezivanje svih zlih sila može zamagliti razliku između ponizne molitve za Božju pomoć i dojma da molitelj samostalno zapovijeda duhovnim silama ili jamči njihov odlazak.

Molitva ne bi trebala stvarati dojam da će njezino izgovaranje samo po sebi ukloniti svako zlo ili svaku opasnost; kršćanska zaštita uključuje pouzdanje u Boga i vjernost Kristu, a ne magijsko shvaćanje formule.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička molitva za zaštitu usmjerena je prvenstveno Bogu, a anđeli i sveci zazivaju se kao zagovornici i pomoćnici u molitvi, ne kao izvori vlasti neovisne o Bogu. Službeni molitveni tekstovi potvrđuju zazivanje Marijina zagovora i molitvu svetom Mihaelu za obranu od zla, pa su ti elementi u odlomku prikladni kada ostaju unutar takvog odnosa povjerenja i prošnje.

De Exorcismis et Supplicationibus Quibusdam (Exorcisms and Other Supplications)

magisterium.assessment_en: The prayer is largely in accordance with Catholic piety: the invocation of God's help, Christ's redeeming blood, and the intercession of Mary, Saint Michael, and the angels corresponds to Catholic prayer practice. Nevertheless, the expression that the person praying in Jesus' name "takes authority" and binds evil forces can sound as though he personally possesses authority over demons, so it would be clearer to formulate the prayer as a petition to God for protection and deliverance.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic prayer for protection is directed primarily to God, and angels and saints are invoked as intercessors and helpers in prayer, not as sources of authority independent of God. Official prayer texts confirm the invocation of Mary's intercession and prayer to Saint Michael for defense against evil, so these elements in the passage are appropriate when they remain within such a relationship of trust and petition.
concerns_en: The formulation "takes authority" and the direct binding of all evil forces can obscure the distinction between humble prayer for God's help and the impression that the person praying independently commands spiritual forces or guarantees their departure.

Prayer should not create the impression that its recitation will in itself remove every evil or every danger; Christian protection includes trust in God and fidelity to Christ, rather than a magical understanding of a formula.

sections.subtitle_en: “Come, you who are blessed by my Father”: beginning with a prayer of deliverance
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Vladimir Grebenar greets viewers and begins the prayer of deliverance and protection
sections.content_en:
A new episode of the podcast **Ora et Labora** begins with a short greeting. Host **Vladimir Grebenar** greets the "viewers and listeners of the media outlet Ora et Labora" and immediately announces the Gospel of the day. Its central thought is Christ's call: **“Come, you who are blessed by my Father.”** That sentence marks the entire episode, entitled *Milosrđe Božje – Oganj vječni i Život vječni?* [God's Mercy – Eternal Fire and Eternal Life?]. After the Sign of the Cross comes the prayer that always comes first in this program, **the prayer of deliverance and protection from evil forces**.

In Jesus' name, Grebenar "takes authority" and binds "all evil powers and forces", which he enumerates in turn: in the air, on earth, in water, in the underworld, in the other world, in nature, and in fire. He glorifies God as the "Lord over the entire universe" and gives Him glory in the name of creation. Then he binds "all demonic forces that have come against us and our families", placing all those gathered under the protection of the **precious blood of Christ** shed on the cross.

The prayer then turns to heavenly intercessors:
- **Mary**, from whom he seeks intercession before the Sacred Heart of Jesus for all families, asking her to "wrap them in her mantle of love, so that the enemy may be terrified";
- **Saint Michael and guardian angels**, whom he calls upon to defend families "in the fight against all the evil roaming through the world".

At the end comes a direct command to the forces of evil to "depart immediately" from those gathered, their homes, and their land. The prayer concludes with thanksgiving to Jesus, "because You are a faithful God and feel with us."

sections.subtitle: Od arkanđela Mihaela do Presvetog Srca: niz posvetnih molitava
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Uvodni molitveni dio nastavlja se nizom tradicionalnih molitava koje Vladimir Grebenar izgovara jednu za drugom, bez stanke i komentara.

Prva je **molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. U njoj se arkanđeo, „vojvoda vojske nebeske”, moli da brani vjernike „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih”. Od njega se traži da Sotonu i druge zle duhove, „koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša”, božanskom snagom strovali u pakao.

Druga je **molitva jedinstva s Isusom**, nježnija i osobnija. Voditelj moli da „naše noge zajedno hode”, da ruke budu „skupljene u jedinstvu”, da srca „kucaju zajedno”, a duše budu u skladu. Uši bi trebale zajedno „slušati tišinu”, pogledi „duboko prodrijeti jedan u drugi”, a usne zajedno moliti kako bi se zadobilo milosrđe vječnoga Oca.

Slijedi **posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu**. U njoj moliteljica i molitelj predaju „čitavo svoje biće, svoje misli, riječi i djela” Djevici Mariji, „sada i u vječnosti”. Cilj je slava Presvetoga Trojstva, posvećenje Crkve i spasenje svijeta. Posebno se moli za milost da se živi dostojno krsnoga posvećenja, da se „neopozivo pripada” Otkupitelju i da se, poput Marije, slušaju poticaji Duha Svetoga.

Niz zaključuje **molitva Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**. Molitelj mu predaje svoje „siromašno srce” i moli da postane ponizno, strpljivo i čisto. Traži zaštitu u opasnostima, utjehu u nevoljama, zdravlje tijela, blagoslov rada i, na kraju, **„milost svete smrti”**.

magisterium.assessment: Opisane molitve uglavnom su usklađene s katoličkom vjerom: molitva svetom Mihaelu odgovara službenom katoličkom tekstu, a posveta Mariji, jedinstvo s Isusom i molitva za svetu smrt mogu se razumjeti kao pobožnost usmjerena Kristu i Presvetom Trojstvu. Važno je da predanje Mariji ne znači štovanje koje pripada samo Bogu, nego traženje njezina zagovora i nasljedovanje njezine vjernosti Kristu.
concerns: Izraz „predajem čitavo svoje biće” Mariji može biti nejasan ako se odvoji od izričito navedenog cilja: slava Trojstva, posvećenje Crkve i pripadnost Otkupitelju; valja jasno očuvati razliku između marijanskog štovanja i klanjanja koje pripada Bogu.

Izvorni tekstovi za molitvu jedinstva s Isusom, posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i molitvu za svetu smrt nisu izravno sadržani u dostupnim izvorima, pa se njihova usklađenost ovdje procjenjuje prema opisu, a ne prema punom tekstu molitava.
magisterium.enrichment: Molitva svetom Mihaelu iz odlomka odgovara tradicionalnoj molitvi koju prenosi službeni katolički obrednik, uključujući molbu da Bog obuzda Sotonu i zaziv arkanđelove pomoći. Pobožnost Presvetom Srcu Isusovu ima biblijski temelj u Kristovu pozivu da učimo od njega, jer je „krotka i ponizna srca”, te u probodenom boku iz kojega su potekli krv i voda; zato molba za poniznost, čistoću i blisku povezanost s Isusom ima jasnu kršćansku usmjerenost.

magisterium.assessment_en: The described prayers are largely aligned with the Catholic faith: the prayer to Saint Michael corresponds to the official Catholic text, and the consecration to Mary, unity with Jesus, and the prayer for a holy death can be understood as piety directed toward Christ and the Most Holy Trinity. It is important that surrender to Mary does not mean the worship that belongs only to God, but rather seeking her intercession and imitating her fidelity to Christ.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The prayer to Saint Michael from the passage corresponds to the traditional prayer transmitted by the official Catholic ritual, including the petition that God restrain Satan and the invocation of the archangel's help. Devotion to the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus has a biblical foundation in Christ's call that we learn from him, for he is "meek and humble of heart," and in the pierced side from which blood and water flowed; therefore, the petition for humility, purity, and close union with Jesus has a clear Christian orientation.
concerns_en: The expression "I surrender my whole being" to Mary can be ambiguous if detached from the explicitly stated goal: the glory of the Trinity, the sanctification of the Church, and belonging to the Redeemer; the distinction between Marian veneration and the adoration that belongs to God must be clearly preserved.

The original texts for the prayer of unity with Jesus, the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary, and the prayer for a holy death are not directly contained in the available sources, so their alignment is assessed here according to the description, rather than according to the full text of the prayers.

sections.subtitle_en: From Michael the Archangel to the Sacred Heart: a series of consecration prayers
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
The introductory prayer segment continues with a series of traditional prayers that Vladimir Grebenar recites one after another, without pause or commentary.

The first is the **prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel**. In it, the archangel, "Prince of the heavenly host", is implored to defend the faithful "in battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil". He is asked, by divine power, to cast into hell Satan and all the other evil spirits "who roam through the world for the ruin of souls".

The second is the **prayer of unity with Jesus**, more tender and personal. The host prays that "our feet journey together", that hands be "gathered in unity", that hearts "beat together", and souls be in harmony. Ears should together "listen to the silence", gazes "penetrate deeply into one another", and lips pray together in order to obtain the mercy of the eternal Father.

There follows the **consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary**. In it, the petitioner surrenders "their entire being, their thoughts, words, and deeds" to the Virgin Mary, "now and in eternity". The goal is the glory of the Most Holy Trinity, the sanctification of the Church, and the salvation of the world. A special prayer is made for the grace to live worthy of baptismal consecration, to "belong irrevocably" to the Redeemer, and, like Mary, to listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit.

The series concludes with the **prayer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus**. The petitioner surrenders their "poor heart" to Him and asks that it become humble, patient, and pure. He seeks protection in dangers, consolation in afflictions, bodily health, blessing of work, and, finally, **“the grace of a holy death”**.

sections.subtitle: Krunica Božjega milosrđa: „Po Njegovoj pregorkoj muci…”
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara molitvu „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo Ti tijelo i krv…” na početku krunice milosrđa
sections.content:
U 00:03:34 Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje **Krunicu Božjega milosrđa**, tematsku okosnicu epizode posvećene milosrđu. Krunica počinje molitvama *Oče naš*, *Zdravo Marijo* i *Vjerovanje*. Potom slijedi pet desetica, a svaka se otvara istom molitvom:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo Ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina Tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.”

Nakon nje deset se puta ponavlja zaziv **„Po Njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.”** Ponavljanje daje molitvi meditativan ritam i ostavlja slušatelju prostor za tihu sabranost.

Krunica se zaključuje riječima da je Bog „milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srđbu” te obećanjem da će se „dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu”. U **završnoj molitvi** voditelj moli „vječnoga Boga, čije je milosrđe neistraživo”. Traži da umnoži milosrđe u vjernicima, „da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo i ne budemo obeshrabreni”. Umjesto toga, vjernici se trebaju s velikim pouzdanjem predati Božjoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje”. Molitva završava zazivom Krista kao **„kralja milosrđa”**.

magisterium.assessment: Opis Krunice Božjega milosrđa i njezine završne molitve u skladu je s katoličkom pobožnošću: molitva prikazuje Ocu Kristovu osobu i njegovu muku te moli milosrđe za grešnike i cijeli svijet. Naglasak na pouzdanju u Boga i predanju njegovoj volji izbjegava shvaćanje molitve kao jamstva da će se svaka pojedinačna želja ostvariti.
magisterium.enrichment: U opisu pobožnosti svete Faustine navodi se da vjernici u Krunici prikazuju Ocu tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo Kristovo te se sjedinjuju s njegovom žrtvom, moleći milosrđe za sebe i cijeli svijet. Isti izvor naglašava pouzdanje, ustrajnost i usklađenost prošnje s Božjom voljom; zato izraz „zadovoljština za grijehe” treba razumjeti u povezanosti s Kristovom jedinstvenom žrtvom, a ne kao njezinu zamjenu.

citations.document_title: Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska: Divine Mercy in My Soul

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy and its closing prayer is in accordance with Catholic piety: the prayer offers to the Father the person of Christ and his passion and asks for mercy on sinners and the whole world. The emphasis on trust in God and surrender to his will avoids understanding prayer as a guarantee that every individual desire will be fulfilled.
magisterium.enrichment_en: In the description of the devotion of Saint Faustina, it is stated that in the Chaplet the faithful offer to the Father the body and blood, soul and divinity of Christ and unite themselves with his sacrifice, praying for mercy for themselves and the whole world. The same source emphasizes trust, perseverance, and the alignment of the petition with God's will; therefore, the expression "atonement for sins" should be understood in connection with Christ's unique sacrifice, and not as its replacement.

sections.subtitle_en: The Chaplet of Divine Mercy: “For the sake of His sorrowful Passion…”
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host recites the prayer “Eternal Father, I offer you the Body and Blood…” at the beginning of the chaplet of mercy
sections.content_en:
At 00:03:34 Vladimir Grebenar announces the **Chaplet of Divine Mercy**, the thematic backbone of the episode dedicated to mercy. The chaplet begins with the prayers *Our Father*, *Hail Mary*, and the *Creed*. Five decades then follow, each opened with the same prayer:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo Ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina Tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.”

After it, the invocation **“For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world”** is repeated ten times. The repetition gives the prayer a meditative rhythm and leaves the listener space for quiet recollection.

The chaplet concludes with the words that God is "merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger" and with the promise that one will "forever sing the mercies of God". In the **closing prayer**, the host prays to the "eternal God, in whom mercy is endless". He asks Him to increase mercy in the faithful, "that in difficult moments we might not despair nor become despondent". Instead, the faithful should surrender themselves with great confidence to God's holy will, "which is Love and Mercy itself". The prayer ends with the invocation of Christ as the **“King of mercy”**.

sections.subtitle: Dušni dan i zahvala za 40 dana posta protiv „duhova nacionalizma i rata”
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje Gospinu krunicu na Dušni dan i govori o završenom postu
sections.content:
Nakon krunice milosrđa Vladimir Grebenar prelazi na **Gospinu krunicu**. Prije molitve iznosi nakanu: budući da je **Dušni dan**, krunicu treba prikazati kao zahvalu Gospi i Presvetom Trojstvu „za milost posta koji je završio”.

Objašnjava da su sudionici molitvene zajednice postili **40 dana, sve do samog kraja listopada**. Zajednička nakana bila je usmjerena **„protiv duhova nacionalizma, duhova rata”**.

Kao potvrdu da je ta nakana bila ispravna, Grebenar navodi **najnoviju Gospinu poruku iz Međugorja**. Prema njegovim riječima, Gospa poziva da se **„s jačom molitvom”** moli za mir u svijetu, „jer je mir ugrožen od mržnje i rata koja je u ljudskim srcima”. Za voditelja je to „tako znakovita potvrda” da je post bio poziv od Gospodina. Zajednica završava 40 dana posta upravo u trenutku kada Gospa poziva na jaču molitvu protiv onoga protiv čega se postilo i molilo. „To se mora reći. To je istina. A istina se mora izgovoriti”, naglašava.

Krunicu zato poziva moliti „iz srca”, kao zahvalu za velike milosti koje je, kako kaže, Gospa udijelila po ovom postu: **da bude mir u hrvatskom narodu**.

magisterium.assessment: Post, molitva za mir i odbacivanje mržnje i rata u skladu su s katoličkim duhovnim životom; crkveno učenje također razlikuje razorni, isključivi nacionalizam od legitimne ljubavi prema vlastitoj domovini. Teološki je, međutim, pretjerano predstavljati podudarnost s navodnom privatnom porukom kao dokaz da je post bio izričito pozvan od Gospodina: privatne objave ne nadopunjuju javnu Objavu i prihvaćaju se razborito, a ne vjerom koja pripada Božjoj objavi.
concerns: Iz dostavljenog odlomka nije moguće provjeriti točan tekst ni status navodne „najnovije” međugorske poruke; stoga tvrdnju o njezinu podudaranju s postom treba iznositi oprezno.

Tvrdnja da je podudarnost poruke i završetka posta „potvrda” kako je post bio poziv od Gospodina prelazi ono što sama podudarnost može dokazati. Crkva uči da privatna objava može pomoći živjeti evanđelje, ali ne zahtijeva pristanak vjere i ne zamjenjuje konačnu Kristovu Objavu.

Izraz „duhovi nacionalizma” valja razjasniti kako ne bi zvučao kao osuda svake ljubavi prema vlastitoj zemlji: crkveni nauk razlikuje legitimno domoljublje od nacionalizma koji prezire druge narode ili traži nadmoć.
magisterium.enrichment: Molitva i post za mir imaju čvrsto mjesto u katoličkoj praksi: papa Ivan Pavao II. pozvao je na post i posebnu molitvu za pravedan i trajan mir te naglasio potrebu obraćenja i ljudske suradnje. Poruke povezane s Međugorjem mogu se razmatrati kao poticaj na molitvu, post, obraćenje i mir, ali ih treba vrednovati u svjetlu evanđelja i crkvenog razlučivanja; sama vremenska podudarnost nije dokaz nadnaravnog podrijetla ili Božje potvrde.

magisterium.assessment_en: Fasting, prayer for peace, and the rejection of hatred and war are in accordance with Catholic spiritual life; Church teaching also distinguishes destructive, exclusive nationalism from legitimate love for one's own homeland. Theologically, however, it is exaggerated to present a coincidence with an alleged private message as proof that the fast was explicitly called by the Lord: private revelations do not supplement public Revelation and are accepted prudently, rather than with the faith that belongs to God's revelation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Prayer and fasting for peace have a solid place in Catholic practice: Pope John Paul II called for fasting and special prayer for a just and lasting peace and emphasized the need for conversion and human cooperation. Messages associated with Medjugorje can be considered as an encouragement to prayer, fasting, conversion, and peace, but they should be evaluated in the light of the Gospel and ecclesial discernment; temporal coincidence alone is not proof of supernatural origin or God's confirmation.
concerns_en: From the provided passage, it is not possible to verify the exact text or status of the alleged "latest" Medjugorje message; therefore, the claim about its coincidence with the fast should be stated cautiously.

The claim that the coincidence of the message and the end of the fast is "confirmation" that the fast was a call from the Lord goes beyond what coincidence alone can prove. The Church teaches that private revelation can help live the Gospel, but does not require the assent of faith and does not replace the definitive Revelation of Christ.

The expression "spirits of nationalism" must be clarified so as not to sound like a condemnation of all love for one's own country: Church teaching distinguishes legitimate patriotism from nationalism that despises other nations or seeks supremacy.

sections.subtitle_en: All Souls' Day and thanksgiving for 40 days of fasting against “spirits of nationalism and war”
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host announces Our Lady's Rosary on All Souls' Day and speaks about the completed fast
sections.content_en:
After the chaplet of mercy, Vladimir Grebenar moves on to **Our Lady's Rosary**. Before praying, he states the intention: since it is **All Souls' Day**, the rosary should be offered in thanksgiving to Our Lady and the Most Holy Trinity "for the grace of the fast that has ended".

He explains that participants in the prayer community fasted for **40 days, right up to the very end of October**. The common intention was directed **“against spirits of nationalism, spirits of war”**.

As confirmation that this intention was right, Grebenar cites the **latest message of Our Lady from Međugorje**. According to his words, Our Lady calls to pray **“with stronger prayer”** for peace in the world, "because peace is endangered by hatred and war which is in human hearts". For the host, that is "such a significant confirmation" that the fast was a calling from the Lord. The community ends 40 days of fasting precisely at the moment when Our Lady calls for stronger prayer against what was fasted and prayed against. "That must be said. That is the truth. And the truth must be spoken", he emphasizes.

He therefore invites to pray the rosary "from the heart", in thanksgiving for the great graces that, as he says, Our Lady granted through this fast: **that there be peace in the Croatian people**.

sections.subtitle: Prosvjedi „skrivene ljevice”: voditelj tvrdi da ih je „ugasio post”
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori o pozivima na prosvjede u Hrvatskoj i stranom financiranju udruga
sections.content:
Iz duhovne nakane Vladimir Grebenar prelazi na aktualna društvena zbivanja. Tvrdi da **ljevica pokušava podići prosvjede** u Hrvatskoj i u njih uključiti mlade. Riječ je, prema njegovu opisu, o mladima koji „možda nisu dovoljno ni svjesni svega što se događa”, od kojih su neki „mlake vjere”, a neki „uopće nisu u vjeri”. Cilj je, kaže, izvesti ih na ulice, „kao što se to događa u zapadnoeuropskim gradovima”.

Naglašava da se zajednica molila upravo protiv toga. Prema njegovu tumačenju, nije slučajno da se pozivi na prosvjede pojavljuju baš kada završava 40-dnevni post. Kao pokretače ne navodi ljevicu kao stranku, nego **„tu ljevicu skrivenu”**, odnosno **razne udruge** koje se, kako tvrdi, financiraju **stranim novcem i iz stranih centara moći**. One, prema njegovim riječima, „pozivaju na ustanak”.

Zaključak iznosi s uvjerenjem: „To je ugašeno postom. To se neće dogoditi u hrvatskom društvu.”

magisterium.assessment: Molitva i post za dobro društva mogu biti katolička duhovna praksa, ali odlomak bez dokaza pripisuje prosvjede skrivenim političkim akterima i stranim centrima moći te zaključuje da ih je post „ugasio”. Takva sigurnost nadilazi ono što se može teološki zaključiti iz posta i riskira zamjenu razboritog političkog prosuđivanja sumnjičenjem i polarizacijom.
concerns: Tvrdnje o skrivenim organizatorima, stranom financiranju i pozivanju na ustanak iznesene su kao činjenice, ali nisu potkrijepljene sadržajem odlomka; katoličko društveno učenje traži ozbiljno prosuđivanje i kritičko mišljenje, a upozorava na lažne vijesti i iracionalne argumente.

Prikaz posta kao uzroka koji je sigurno spriječio određeni politički događaj može sugerirati da post djeluje kao jamstvo određenoga društvenog ishoda; dostupni biblijski tekst post povezuje s obraćenjem, pravdom i brigom za ugrožene, a ne s mehaničkim upravljanjem političkim događajima.

Označavanje mladih i političkih skupina kao dijela prijetnje, bez razmatranja njihovih stvarnih motiva i postupaka, može poticati nepravednu osudu; kršćani su pozvani djelovati za dobro u društvu, ali ne smiju ljudsko političko prosuđivanje poistovjetiti s konačnim Božjim sudom.
magisterium.enrichment: Post je u biblijskom smislu najplodniji kada vodi obraćenju, djelima milosrđa i uklanjanju nepravde: prorok Izaija povezuje pravi post s oslobađanjem potlačenih i dijeljenjem kruha gladnima. Vjernici mogu moliti za mir i sudjelovati u javnom životu, ali političke tvrdnje valja provjeravati, a protivnike prosuđivati pravedno i bez preuranjenog pripisivanja skrivenih motiva.

magisterium.assessment_en: Prayer and fasting for the good of society can be Catholic spiritual practice, but the passage without evidence attributes protests to hidden political actors and foreign power centers and concludes that fasting "extinguished" them. Such certainty exceeds what can be theologically deduced from fasting and risks replacing prudent political judgment with suspicion and polarization.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Fasting in the biblical sense is most fruitful when it leads to conversion, works of mercy, and the removal of injustice: the prophet Isaiah connects true fasting with freeing the oppressed and sharing bread with the hungry. The faithful may pray for peace and participate in public life, but political claims must be verified, and opponents judged justly and without premature attribution of hidden motives.
concerns_en: Claims about hidden organizers, foreign funding, and calling for an uprising are presented as facts, but are not supported by the content of the passage; Catholic social teaching requires serious judgment and critical thinking, and warns against fake news and irrational arguments.

Presenting fasting as a cause that certainly prevented a particular political event can suggest that fasting acts as a guarantee of a specific social outcome; the available biblical text connects fasting with conversion, justice, and care for the vulnerable, rather than with mechanical control over political events.

Labeling youth and political groups as part of a threat, without considering their actual motives and actions, can encourage unjust condemnation; Christians are called to act for the good in society, but must not equate human political judgment with God's final judgment.

sections.subtitle_en: Protests of the “hidden left”: host claims that “the fast extinguished them”
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host speaks about calls for protests in Croatia and foreign funding of associations
sections.content_en:
From spiritual intentions, Vladimir Grebenar moves on to current social events. He asserts that **the left is trying to raise protests** in Croatia and involve young people in them. According to his description, these are young people who "perhaps are not even sufficiently aware of everything happening", some of whom are of "lukewarm faith", and some "not in the faith at all". The goal, he says, is to bring them out onto the streets, "just as is happening in Western European cities".

He emphasizes that the community prayed against precisely that. According to his interpretation, it is no coincidence that calls for protests appear just as the 40-day fast is ending. As instigators he points not to the left as a political party, but to **“that hidden left”**, namely **various associations** that are funded, as he claims, with **foreign money and from foreign centers of power**. They, according to his words, "are calling for an uprising".

He delivers his conclusion with conviction: "That was extinguished by the fast. That will not happen in Croatian society."

sections.subtitle: Pad „najvećeg ratnog huškača na Balkanu”: „samo jedna utakmica u dugačkom prvenstvu”
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj komentira pad s vlasti političara u Srbiji kojeg naziva ratnim huškačem
sections.content:
Drugi plod posta Vladimir Grebenar vidi izvan granica Hrvatske. Kaže da je **u Srbiji pao s vlasti „najveći ratni huškač na Balkanu”**. Ime ne navodi, nego ga opisuje kao čovjeka koji je huškao tijekom Domovinskog rata, i u Hrvatskoj i u Bosni i Hercegovini. Prema njegovim riječima, taj je političar tvrdio da za jednog poginulog Srbina „treba, ne znam, mislim 10 ili 100 Bošnjaka platiti glavom”.

Voditelj ga optužuje da je pridonio „krvavom piru” u Hrvatskoj i u BiH, a kao primjer navodi **Srebrenicu**. Dodaje da je bio ponovno u koaliciji sa **Šešeljem**, „istim onim čovjekom” s kojim je, kako kaže, hodao po Hrvatskoj i BiH te po planinama oko Sarajeva.

Pad s vlasti Grebenar opisuje kao **„čudesan, neobjašnjiv”**, takav da ga „niko ne može objasniti”. Duhovno ga tumači ovako: preko tog političara „neprijatelj đavao htio je posijati rat ovdje”. Navodi da je dotični naoružavao zemlju i otvoreno govorio da će biti rata. Prema voditelju, na „demonski subverzivan način” tvrdio je da će Hrvatska napasti Srbiju i time opravdavao kupnju oružja i najavljenu proizvodnju balističkih raketa.

Voditelj ipak upozorava da ne treba likovati. Služi se sportskom metaforom: to je **„samo jedna bitka”**, odnosno **„samo jedna utakmica u dugačkom prvenstvu koje je tek započelo”**. „To su posljednja vremena, braćo i sestre”, zaključuje te poziva vjernike da ostanu „čvrsti, ujedinjeni u molitvi i u postu”.

magisterium.assessment: Osuda ratnog huškanja, molitva za mir i upozorenje protiv likovanja u skladu su s kršćanskim mirotvorstvom, ali odlomak iznosi snažne političke i povijesne optužbe bez mogućnosti da ih se ovdje provjeri te događaj tumači kao čudesan Božji zahvat i đavolsku djelatnost s velikom sigurnošću. Poziv na „posljednja vremena” može biti kršćanski podsjetnik na budnost, no ne bi smio stvarati dojam da se određeni politički događaji mogu pouzdano čitati kao znak posebnog apokaliptičkog trenutka.
concerns: Tvrdnje o identitetu političara, njegovim postupcima, koaliciji i ulozi u ratovima nisu potkrijepljene izvorima dostupnima za ovu procjenu, pa se njihova povijesna točnost ne može potvrditi.

Pripisivanje političkog razvoja „neprijatelju đavlu” može zanemariti ljudsku odgovornost i složenost političkih uzroka ako se iznosi kao potpuno objašnjenje; kršćanski govor o duhovnoj borbi ne ukida odgovornost ljudi za vlastite odluke.

Izjava da su to „posljednja vremena” traži oprez: kršćanska nada uključuje konačni Kristov sud, ali ljudima ne daje ovlast da konačni sud preuzimaju niti da povijesne događaje bez dostatnog temelja proglase njegovim neposrednim znakom.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko razumijevanje povijesti drži zajedno dvije istine: zlo i duhovna borba stvarni su, ali politička društva ostaju nesavršena i nisu isto što i Kraljevstvo Božje; konačno razlučivanje pripada Bogu. Zato su molitva i post primjeren odgovor ako hrane mir, istinoljubivost i odgovorno djelovanje, dok opasnost rata treba prosuđivati pažljivo, bez likovanja i bez neutemeljenih apokaliptičkih zaključaka.

magisterium.assessment_en: The condemnation of warmongering, prayer for peace, and a warning against gloating are in accordance with Christian peacemaking, but the passage makes strong political and historical accusations without the possibility of verifying them here, and interprets the event as a miraculous divine intervention and devilish activity with great certainty. The invocation of the "end times" can be a Christian reminder of vigilance, but it should not create the impression that certain political events can be reliably read as a sign of a particular apocalyptic moment.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic understanding of history holds together two truths: evil and spiritual warfare are real, but political societies remain imperfect and are not the same as the Kingdom of God; definitive discernment belongs to God. Therefore, prayer and fasting are an appropriate response if they nourish peace, truthfulness, and responsible action, while the danger of war should be judged carefully, without gloating and without unfounded apocalyptic conclusions.
concerns_en: Claims about the identity of the politician, his actions, the coalition, and role in wars are not supported by the sources available for this assessment, so their historical accuracy cannot be confirmed.

Attributing political development to the "enemy devil" can overlook human responsibility and the complexity of political causes if presented as a complete explanation; Christian speech about spiritual warfare does not eliminate people's responsibility for their own decisions.

The statement that these are the "end times" requires caution: Christian hope includes Christ's final judgment, but does not give humans authority to take over final judgment nor to declare historical events without sufficient foundation as its immediate sign.

sections.subtitle_en: Fall of the “biggest warmonger in the Balkans”: “just one match in a long championship”
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host comments on the fall from power of a politician in Serbia whom he calls a warmonger
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar sees another fruit of fasting outside the borders of Croatia. He says that **in Serbia the "biggest warmonger in the Balkans" fell from power**. He does not name him, but describes him as a man who warmongered during the Homeland War, both in Croatia and in Bosnia and Herzegovina. According to his words, that politician claimed that for one dead Serb, "I don't know, I think 10 or 100 Bosniaks must pay with their lives".

The host accuses him of contributing to the "bloody feast" in Croatia and in BiH, citing **Srebrenica** as an example. He adds that he was again in coalition with **Šešelj**, "the very same man" with whom, as he says, he walked through Croatia and BiH and on the mountains around Sarajevo.

Grebenar describes the fall from power as **“miraculous, inexplicable”**, such that "no one can explain it". He interprets it spiritually in this way: through that politician, "the enemy the devil wanted to sow war here". He states that the person was arming the country and openly saying there would be war. According to the host, in a "demonically subversive way" he claimed that Croatia would attack Serbia, thereby justifying the purchase of weapons and the announced production of ballistic missiles.

The host nevertheless warns against gloating. He uses a sports metaphor: it is **“only one battle”**, namely **“only one match in a long championship that has only just begun”**. "These are the end times, brothers and sisters", he concludes, calling on the faithful to remain "firm, united in prayer and in fasting".

sections.subtitle: Post se nastavlja po abecedi: „svaki dan barem 1000 ljudi koji poste”
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj objašnjava raspored posta po početnim slovima prezimena

magisterium.assessment: Poziv na dobrovoljan post, molitvu i prikazivanje žrtve Gospodinu uglavnom je u skladu s katoličkom pokorničkom praksom, a savjet da se post skrati ili prekine kada postane pretežak pokazuje korisnu umjerenost. Ipak, raspored i post o kruhu i vodi predstavljeni su kao privatna pobožna inicijativa, a ne kao obveza za sve katolike; tvrdnju da je upravo takav post „najjači” ne treba shvatiti kao opće crkveno mjerilo.
concerns: Nije potkrijepljeno da Gospa u Međugorju doista traži upravo ovaj raspored ni da je takav oblik posta obvezan; odlomak ga treba jasno prikazati kao osobni poziv, a ne kao crkvenu zapovijed.
Biblijski i kršćanski smisao posta ne mjeri se samo strogošću ili uskraćivanjem hrane. Naglašavanje kruha i vode kao najjačeg oblika može zasjeniti obraćenje, molitvu i ljubav prema bližnjemu.
Dugotrajan ili strog post nije prikladan za svakoga. Savjet o skraćivanju i odmoru ublažava problem, ali bilo bi korisno jasnije naznačiti da se post treba razborito prilagoditi osobnim okolnostima.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička tradicija cijeni post, mutta korostaa myös sen sisäistä tarkoitusta: se on rukouksen ja obraćenja pomoć, a ne natjecanje u strogosti; sv. Jeronim izričito preporučuje post koji je umjeren i primjeren čovjekovoj snazi. Isus upozorava da se post ne vrši radi ljudske pohvale, a crkveni izvori podsjećaju i na obzir prema drugima i njihovoj savjesti. Zato je dobro da se post slobodno prikazuje Bogu, ali ga treba povezivati s molitvom, obraćenjem i djelima ljubavi.

citations.document_author: Eusebius Sophronius Hieronymus (Jerome of Stridon or St. Jerome)

magisterium.assessment_en: The call for voluntary fasting, prayer, and offering sacrifice to the Lord is largely in accordance with Catholic penitential practice, and the advice to shorten or stop fasting when it becomes too difficult shows useful moderation. Nevertheless, the schedule and fasting on bread and water are presented as a private pious initiative, and not as an obligation for all Catholics; the claim that precisely such fasting is the "strongest" should not be understood as a general Church standard.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic tradition values fasting, but also emphasizes its inner purpose: it is a help to prayer and conversion, not a competition in severity; Saint Jerome explicitly recommends fasting that is moderate and appropriate to human strength. Jesus warns that fasting is not done for human praise, and Church sources also recall consideration for others and their conscience. Therefore, it is good that fasting is freely offered to God, but it should be connected with prayer, conversion, and works of love.
concerns_en: It is not substantiated that Our Lady in Medjugorje indeed requests precisely this schedule or that such a form of fasting is obligatory; the passage should clearly present it as a personal call, rather than an ecclesial command.

The biblical and Christian meaning of fasting is not measured solely by severity or deprivation of food. Emphasizing bread and water as the strongest form can overshadow conversion, prayer, and love for one's neighbor.

Long-term or severe fasting is not suitable for everyone. Advice on shortening and resting mitigates the problem, but it would be useful to indicate more clearly that fasting should be prudently adapted to personal circumstances.

sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj kritizira međureligijske molitvene skupove i zajedničke postove
sections.content:
Vladimir Grebenar naglašava da je bitno da **poste oni koji vjeruju u Isusa Krista**. Odbacuje postove u kojima se, kako kaže, „ujedinjuju ljudi drugih religija”: „To je ništa od toga, braćo i sestre. To je **medijsko naslikavanje**.”

Istu ocjenu daje i za ono što naziva **„duhom Siza”**. Pod time podrazumijeva okupljanja na kojima se sastaju vođe raznih religija, a s njima i katolički biskupi. „To nema nikakvu snagu. **To razara Crkvu**”, tvrdi voditelj.

Svoje stajalište ovako obrazlaže:
- postiti trebaju **kršćani, katolici**, „jer mi znamo kome postimo, Presvetom Trojstvu”;
- osoba druge religije koja bi željela postiti zajedno s katolicima **„mora priznati da je Isus Krist Sin Božji”**;
- pripadnici drugih religija, kaže, „poste svojim bogovima” hinduizma, budizma i islama, a „mi ne vjerujemo u te bogove”.

Zaključuje da je važno „ustrajati u onome što je Gospodinovo djelo”, a to je **vršiti Božju svetu volju do kraja**.

magisterium.assessment: Ispovijedanje da je Isus Krist Sin Božji i da je spasenje u njemu središnje je katoličko uvjerenje, no tvrdnje da međureligijski susreti nemaju nikakvu snagu i razaraju Crkvu ozbiljno su protivne katoličkom učenju o dijalogu i susretu u Asizu. Odlomak također netočno svodi vjeru muslimana na vjerovanje u boga različitog od Boga kojega štuju kršćani.
concerns: Crkveno učenje dopušta, u iznimnim i pažljivo pripremljenim okolnostima, okupljanje ljudi različitih religija radi molitve za određenu nakanu, uz jasno razlikovanje pojedinačnih molitava i izbjegavanje sinkretizma; zato takve susrete nije opravdano općenito nazivati bezvrijednima ili razornima.
Katolička vjera čvrsto ispovijeda da je Krist jedini Spasitelj, ali istodobno potiče poštovanje prema drugim religijskim tradicijama i priznaje da u njima mogu postojati elementi istine i dobrote.

Tvrdnja da muslimani poste „svojim bogovima” pogrešno prikazuje islamsku vjeru: katoličko učenje izričito navodi da muslimani štuju jednoga Boga, iako kršćani s njima ne dijele potpuno isto razumijevanje Boga kao Presvetoga Trojstva.

Postavljanje izričitog priznanja Isusa Krista kao uvjeta za sudjelovanje osobe druge vjere u svakom obliku zajedničkog posta nije potkrijepljeno navedenim crkvenim učenjem. Potrebno je razlikovati zajedničku liturgijsku molitvu, koju treba izbjegavati, od susreta u kojem sudionici mole odvojeno ili se okupljaju radi mira.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički međureligijski dijalog ne znači da se od kršćana traži da oslabe ili prikriju vjeru u Krista: sudionici trebaju pristupati susretu vjerni vlastitom uvjerenju i istodobno otvoreni za poštovanje drugih. U smjernicama za takve susrete razlikuje se „biti zajedno radi molitve” od „zajedničke molitve”, a odbacuju se postupci koji bi stvarali dojam da su sve religije iste. Takvo razlikovanje omogućuje istodobno vjerno svjedočenje Kristu, odbacivanje sinkretizma i poštovanje dostojanstva ljudi drugih vjera.
magisterium.assessment_en: Professing that Jesus Christ is the Son of God and that salvation is in him is a central Catholic conviction, but claims that interreligious meetings have no power and destroy the Church are seriously contrary to Catholic teaching on dialogue and the Assisi meeting. The passage also inaccurately reduces the faith of Muslims to belief in a god different from the God whom Christians worship.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic interreligious dialogue does not mean that Christians are required to weaken or conceal faith in Christ: participants should approach the encounter faithful to their own conviction and at the same time open to respect for others. In guidelines for such meetings, a distinction is made between "being together to pray" and "praying together," and practices that would create the impression that all religions are the same are rejected. Such a distinction makes possible at once faithful witness to Christ, rejection of syncretism, and respect for the dignity of people of other faiths.
concerns_en: Church teaching permits, in exceptional and carefully prepared circumstances, the gathering of people of different religions to pray for a specific intention, with a clear distinction between individual prayers and the avoidance of syncretism; therefore, it is not justified to describe such meetings generally as worthless or destructive.

The Catholic faith firmly professes that Christ is the only Savior, but at the same time encourages respect for other religious traditions and recognizes that elements of truth and goodness can exist in them.

The claim that Muslims fast to "their gods" misrepresents Islamic faith: Catholic teaching explicitly states that Muslims worship the one God, although Christians do not share with them completely the same understanding of God as the Most Holy Trinity.

Setting an explicit acknowledgment of Jesus Christ as a condition for the participation of a person of another faith in any form of shared fasting is not supported by the cited Church teaching. It is necessary to distinguish shared liturgical prayer, which should be avoided, from an encounter in which participants pray separately or gather for the sake of peace.

sections.subtitle_en: Sharp criticism of interreligious fasts: “That is media posturing”
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host criticizes interreligious prayer gatherings and joint fasts
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar emphasizes that it is essential that **those who believe in Jesus Christ fast**. He rejects fasts in which, as he puts it, "people of other religions unite": "That is nothing of the sort, brothers and sisters. That is **media posturing**."

He gives the same assessment to what he calls the **“spirit of Assisi”**. By that he means gatherings where leaders of various religions meet, and with them Catholic bishops. "That has no power whatsoever. **That destroys the Church**", the host claims.

He explains his position as follows:
- those who should fast are **Christians, Catholics**, "because we know to whom we fast, to the Most Holy Trinity";
- a person of another religion who would wish to fast together with Catholics **“must acknowledge that Jesus Christ is the Son of God”**;
- members of other religions, he says, "fast to their gods" of Hinduism, Buddhism, and Islam, and "we do not believe in those gods".

He concludes that it is important to "persevere in that which is the Lord's work", which is **to do God's holy will to the end**.

sections.subtitle: Radosna otajstva: pet desetica zahvale
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj započinje prvo radosno otajstvo i najavljuje šestu deseticu za duše u čistilištu
sections.content:
Prije prvog otajstva Vladimir Grebenar napominje da je Dušni dan. Zato će se na kraju izmoliti i **šesta desetica, za duše u čistilištu**. Zatim počinje molitva **radosnih otajstava** Gospine krunice. Svako otajstvo sastoji se od molitve *Oče naš*, deset *Zdravo Marijo* i *Slava Ocu*:

1. **„Koga si, Djevice, po Duhu Svetom začela”**
2. **„Koga si, Djevice, idući Elizabeti u pohodu nosila”**
3. **„Koga si, Djevice, rodila”**
4. **„Koga si, Djevice, u hramu prikazala”**
5. **„Koga si, Djevice, u hramu našla”**

Svaku deseticu zaključuje **fatimska molitva**, koja se uklapa u temu epizode o oganju vječnom i životu vječnom:

> „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe, očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja, dovedi u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.”

Krunica traje dvadesetak minuta. Moli se kao zahvala za milosti 40-dnevnog posta i za mir u hrvatskom narodu, kako je voditelj najavio na početku.

magisterium.assessment: Opis molitve uglavnom je u skladu s katoličkom pobožnošću: radosna otajstva usmjeravaju razmatranje na Kristov život, a Marijina uloga prikazana je kao majčinska i posrednička, ne kao zamjena za Krista. Dodatna šesta desetica i fatimska molitva mogu se razumjeti kao pobožni dodatak, a ne kao tvrdnja da su dio uobičajenog ustaljenog oblika krunice.
magisterium.enrichment: Krunica nije samo ponavljanje molitava nego i razmatranje Kristovih otajstava; Marija u toj molitvi vjernike vodi prema Kristu i zagovara za njih. Molitva za pokojne posebno je prikladna na Dušni dan: Sveto pismo bilježi takvu praksu u 2 Mak 12, a crkveno učenje povezuje je sa zajedništvom svetih.

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the prayer is largely in accordance with Catholic piety: the joyful mysteries direct contemplation to Christ's life, and Mary's role is presented as maternal and mediatory, not as a replacement for Christ. The additional sixth decade and Fatima prayer can be understood as a pious addition, rather than a claim that they are part of the customary established form of the Rosary.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Rosary is not merely a repetition of prayers but also contemplation of Christ's mysteries; Mary in this prayer leads the faithful toward Christ and intercedes for them. Prayer for the deceased is especially appropriate on All Souls' Day: Sacred Scripture records such a practice in 2 Maccabees 12, and Church teaching connects it with the communion of saints.

sections.subtitle_en: The Joyful Mysteries: five decades of thanksgiving
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host begins the first Joyful Mystery and announces a sixth decade for the souls in purgatory
sections.content_en:
Before the first mystery, Vladimir Grebenar notes that it is All Souls' Day. Therefore, at the end, a **sixth decade** will also be prayed, **for the souls in purgatory**. Then begins the prayer of the **Joyful Mysteries** of Our Lady's Rosary. Each mystery consists of the prayer *Our Father*, ten *Hail Marys*, and the *Glory Be*:

1. **“Whom you, O Virgin, conceived by the Holy Spirit”**
2. **“Whom you, O Virgin, carried when visiting Elizabeth”**
3. **“To whom you, O Virgin, gave birth”**
4. **“Whom you, O Virgin, presented in the temple”**
5. **“Whom you, O Virgin, found in the temple”**

Each decade concludes with the **Fatima prayer**, which fits the episode's theme of eternal fire and eternal life:

> „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe, očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja, dovedi u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.”

The Rosary lasts about twenty minutes. It is prayed in thanksgiving for the graces of the 40-day fast and for peace in the Croatian people, as the host announced at the beginning.

sections.subtitle: Šesta desetica za vjerne mrtve i nerođene te „Zdravo Kraljice”
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje šestu deseticu za duše u čistilištu i nerođenu djecu
sections.content:
Na kraju krunice Vladimir Grebenar dodaje najavljenu **šestu deseticu za duše u čistilištu**, kako priliči Dušnom danu. Nakanu izriče ovako: neka se Gospodin **„smiluje vjernim mrtvima, izbavi duše iz čistilišta, iscijeli rane pobačenima, nerođenima”**. Tako uz preminule obuhvaća i nerođenu djecu.

Desetica se moli istim redom kao i prethodne: *Oče naš*, deset *Zdravo Marijo*, *Slava Ocu* i fatimska molitva sa zazivom da Isus „dovede u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe”.

Krunica završava antifonom **„Zdravo Kraljice, majko milosrđa”**. U njoj se vjernici, „prognani sinovi Evini”, obraćaju Mariji „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini”. Mole je da „svrne svoje milostive oči” na njih i da im „poslije ovoga progona pokaže Isusa, blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje”.

Nakon završnog *Slava Ocu* voditelj najavljuje novi dio emisije: **„Slijedi tumačenje svete riječi.”**

magisterium.assessment: Molitva za vjerne mrtve i zaziv da se duše izbave iz čistilišta u skladu su s katoličkom praksom molitve za pokojne, a „Zdravo Kraljice” pravilno izražava Marijino majčinsko zagovorništvo i usmjerava vjernike prema Isusu. Izraz o „iscjeljenju rana pobačenima, nerođenima” nije sam po sebi jasno protivan nauku, ali je dvoznačan i traži preciznije objašnjenje.
concerns: Nije jasno odnosi li se „iscijeli rane” na osobe i obitelji ranjene pobačajem ili na nerođenu djecu; preciznija nakana spriječila bi zabunu. Ako se izraz odnosi na nerođenu djecu, ne treba njime sugerirati bez dodatnog pojašnjenja da je njihov položaj u čistilištu utvrđen.
magisterium.enrichment: Molitva za pokojne nije zazivanje mrtvih niti pokušaj komunikacije s njima, nego zagovorna molitva unutar zajedništva svetih; 2 Mak 12,43–46 navodi molitvu i žrtvu za mrtve kao pobožnu praksu. U „Zdravo Kraljice” Marija se zaziva kao Majka milosrđa, ali završna nada usmjerena je na susret s Isusom, a ne na Mariju odvojeno od njega.

magisterium.assessment_en: Prayer for the faithful departed and the invocation that souls be delivered from purgatory are in accordance with Catholic practice of prayer for the deceased, and the "Hail Holy Queen" properly expresses Mary's maternal intercession and directs the faithful toward Jesus. The expression about the "healing of wounds for the aborted, the unborn" is not in itself clearly contrary to doctrine, but is ambiguous and requires a more precise explanation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Prayer for the deceased is not an invocation of the dead nor an attempt at communication with them, but rather intercessory prayer within the communion of saints; 2 Maccabees 12:43–46 cites prayer and sacrifice for the dead as a pious practice. In the "Hail Holy Queen," Mary is invoked as Mother of Mercy, but the final hope is directed toward an encounter with Jesus, and not toward Mary separately from him.
concerns_en: It is not clear whether "heal wounds" refers to persons and families wounded by abortion or to unborn children; a more precise intention would prevent confusion. If the expression refers to unborn children, one should not suggest by it without additional clarification that their status in purgatory is established.

sections.subtitle_en: A sixth decade for the faithful departed and the unborn, and the “Hail, Holy Queen”
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host announces a sixth decade for the souls in purgatory and unborn children
sections.content_en:
At the end of the rosary, Vladimir Grebenar adds the announced **sixth decade for the souls in purgatory**, as is fitting for All Souls' Day. He articulates the intention thus: may the Lord **“have mercy on the faithful departed, deliver souls from purgatory, heal the wounds of the aborted, the unborn”**. Thus, alongside the deceased, he includes unborn children.

The decade is prayed in the same order as the previous ones: *Our Father*, ten *Hail Marys*, the *Glory Be*, and the Fatima prayer with the petition that Jesus "bring all souls to heaven, especially those in most need of your mercy".

The rosary ends with the antiphon **“Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of Mercy”**. In it, the faithful, "poor banished children of Eve", turn to Mary, "mourning and weeping in this valley of tears". They pray her to "turn then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us" and "after this exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus".

After the final *Glory Be*, the host announces the new part of the broadcast: **“Next follows the interpretation of the Holy Word.”**

sections.subtitle: Izaijino proroštvo: zastor koji prekriva sve narode
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar tumači Izaijin pokrivač kao tamni oblak smrti nad narodima
sections.content:
Nakon molitve krunice Vladimir Grebenar prelazi na tumačenje svete riječi. Čita odlomak iz **Knjige proroka Izaije**: Gospodin nad vojskama priredit će svim narodima na gori gozbu od pretiline, raskinut će zastor koji zastire sve narode i pokrivač koji pokriva sva plemena, uništit će smrt zauvijek, otrti suzu sa svakog lica i skinuti sramotu svoga naroda. Odlomak završava klicanjem: „Gle, ovo je Bog naš, u njega se uzdasmo, on nas je spasio.“

Grebenar to naziva važnim proroštvom. Ističe da poruka nije bila namijenjena samo izraelskom narodu osam stoljeća prije Krista. Kao zapisana i živa Božja riječ, kaže, odnosi se i na današnje vrijeme. Zato postavlja ključno pitanje: kakav je to pokrivač koji zastire sve narode?

Odgovor traži u duhovnoj sferi, u svijetu koji se ne vidi prirodnim očima, iako ga, prema njegovim riječima, neki imaju milost vidjeti. Govori o svojevrsnoj **duhovnoj kulisi ili scenografiji koja nije nimalo bezazlena**. Sveto pismo smatra duhovnom knjigom koja otkriva duhovnu stvarnost. Izaija je, tumači on, taj pokrivač doista vidio jer mu ga je Bog pokazao: riječ je o **tamnom oblaku smrti koji se nadvije nad neki prostor**.

Naglašava da prirodne okolnosti tu ništa ne govore. Dan može biti sunčan, oblaci svijetli ili nebo potpuno vedro, a da u duhovnom svijetu nad tim područjem ipak leži tamni prekrivač. Sunce izlazi i zalazi nad svim narodima kao prirodno svjetlo. Grebenar međutim drži da priroda i materija na skrovit način otkrivaju i poučavaju o onome što je duhovno. Dodaje da su do te spoznaje razumom došli još i antički filozofi.

magisterium.assessment: Dobro prepoznaje da Izaijina slika ima značenje šire od povijesnog Izraela te da se u kršćanskom čitanju povezuje s Kristovom pobjedom nad smrću i konačnim spasenjem svih naroda. Međutim, tvrdnja da je zastor konkretan tamni oblak smrti koji se nadvija nad određenim područjem i koji je Izaija vidio u duhovnoj viziji nije utvrđena samim tekstom niti je potkrijepljena ovdje navedenim katoličkim tumačenjima.
concerns: Izaija govori o zastoru nad svim narodima i o smrti koju će Bog uništiti; odlomak ne opisuje taj zastor kao vidljivu ili posebno opažljivu duhovnu pojavu nad pojedinim geografskim područjem.
Predstavljanje takve konkretne slike kao onoga što je prorok doista vidio može zamijeniti biblijski simbol i crkveno tumačenje nagađanjem ili privatnim duhovnim dojmom.
magisterium.enrichment: Izaija 25 prikazuje gozbu za sve narode, uklanjanje zastora, pobjedu nad smrću i brisanje suza; kršćanska tradicija to čita Kristološki i eshatološki, eli kao navještaj spasenja u Kristu i konačnog ispunjenja. Ivan Pavao II. tumači zastor kao ono što zaklanja čovjekov unutarnji pogled na Božju istinu, a gozbu i goru povezuje s Euharistijom i Crkvom kao anticipacijom uskrsnuća, ne s oblakom nad određenim područjem.

magisterium.assessment_en: It rightly recognizes that Isaiah's image has a meaning broader than historical Israel and that in Christian reading it is connected with Christ's victory over death and the final salvation of all nations. However, the claim that the veil is a concrete dark cloud of death that hovers over a particular area and which Isaiah saw in a spiritual vision is not established by the text itself nor supported by the Catholic interpretations cited here.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Isaiah 25 depicts a feast for all peoples, the removal of the veil, victory over death, and the wiping away of tears; Christian tradition reads this Christologically and eschatologically, namely as a proclamation of salvation in Christ and final fulfillment. John Paul II interprets the veil as that which covers man's inner gaze upon God's truth, and connects the feast and the mountain with the Eucharist and the Church as an anticipation of the resurrection, not with a cloud over a particular area.
concerns_en: Isaiah speaks of a veil over all peoples and of death which God will destroy; the passage does not describe that veil as a visible or particularly observable spiritual phenomenon over an individual geographical area.
Presenting such a concrete image as what the prophet actually saw can replace biblical symbolism and ecclesial interpretation with speculation or a private spiritual impression.

sections.subtitle_en: Isaiah's prophecy: the veil that covers all peoples
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar interprets Isaiah's veil as a dark cloud of death over the nations
sections.content_en:
After praying the rosary, Vladimir Grebenar moves on to the interpretation of the Holy Word. He reads a passage from the **Book of the Prophet Isaiah**: on this mountain the Lord of hosts will make for all peoples a feast of rich food, He will destroy the veil that veils all peoples and the sheet that covers all nations, He will swallow up death forever, wipe away tears from every face, and remove the reproach of His people. The passage ends with acclaim: "Behold, this is our God; we have waited for Him, that He might save us."

Grebenar calls this an important prophecy. He emphasizes that the message was not intended only for the people of Israel eight centuries before Christ. As the written and living Word of God, he says, it applies to our time as well. Therefore, he poses the key question: what kind of veil is it that covers all peoples?

He seeks the answer in the spiritual sphere, in a world not seen with natural eyes, although, according to his words, some have the grace to see it. He speaks of a kind of **spiritual backdrop or scenery that is not at all harmless**. He considers Sacred Scripture to be a spiritual book that reveals spiritual reality. Isaiah, he interprets, truly saw that veil because God showed it to him: it is a matter of a **dark cloud of death that hangs over a space**.

He emphasizes that natural circumstances say nothing here. The day may be sunny, the clouds bright, or the sky completely clear, yet in the spiritual world a dark covering nevertheless lies over that area. The sun rises and sets over all peoples as natural light. Grebenar, however, holds that nature and matter in a hidden way reveal and teach about that which is spiritual. He adds that ancient philosophers had also arrived at that insight through reason.

sections.subtitle: Sunce kao slika Krista i dar slobodne volje
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori o izboru između svjetla i tame
sections.content:
Grebenar se vraća slici koju, kako kaže, često ponavlja: **sunce je slika Božje svjetlosti, a ta svjetlost je Isus Krist**. Zato se Isusa naziva mladim suncem, kako stoji u Knjizi Otkrivenja. Iz iste slike tumači i Gospu „zaodjenutu u sunce“: ona je u svojoj utrobi nosila Isusa, koji je svjetlost. Podsjeća i na proslov Ivanova evanđelja: svjetlost je došla na svijet, ali su ljudi više voljeli tamu nego svjetlost jer su im djela bila zla.

Iz toga izvodi pouku o **slobodnoj volji**. Bog čovjeku daje slobodu da sam bira između svjetlosti i tame te kakva će djela činiti, a vjernik to mora prihvatiti. Ilustrira to iskustvom sa skupova koje vodi. Ljudi mu, osobito žene, često priđu i požale se da im je sin krenuo krivim putem, da kći živi s dečkom ili da se u obitelji događaju i gore stvari. Pitaju ga što da rade i kako da to prestane.

Njegov je odgovor dvojak. S jedne strane, treba moliti i postiti za dijete, supruga i druge ukućane. S druge strane, ako nakon nekog vremena nema promjene, treba prihvatiti da je riječ o izboru slobodne volje te osobe.

magisterium.assessment: Središnja poruka da je Krist svjetlost, da Marija u biblijskoj slici nosi odsjaj te božanske svjetlosti i da ljudi slobodno odgovaraju na svjetlo ili tamu uglavnom je u skladu s katoličkim razumijevanjem. Ipak, tvrdnja da Otkrivenje Isusa naziva „mladim suncem” nije potkrijepljena navedenim biblijskim odlomkom, a poštovanje tuđe slobode ne bi trebalo značiti odustajanje od molitve, ljubavi, razgovora i poziva na obraćenje.
concerns: Otkrivenje opisuje ženu zaodjenutu suncem; iz toga se ne može bez dodatnog objašnjenja zaključiti da knjiga Isusa naziva „mladim suncem”. Izraz je potrebno razlikovati od biblijske slike i navesti njegov drugi izvor ako se želi zadržati.

Prihvatiti da druga osoba slobodno odlučuje ne znači smatrati svaki njezin izbor moralno dobrim niti zaključiti da se više ništa ne može učiniti. Takva formulacija, ako se shvati kao odustajanje nakon što nema brze promjene, može zvučati rezignirano.
magisterium.enrichment: Ivanovo evanđelje povezuje Krista sa svjetlošću koja dolazi na svijet, dok slika Marije zaodjenute suncem u Otkrivenju može biti protumačena u vezi s božanskom svjetlošću i životom koji dolazi po njezinu Sinu. Katolički prikaz te slike naglašava Krista kao svjetlo svijeta, a Mariju kao onu koja je zaodjenuta njegovim božanskim svjetlom. Molitva za bližnje može stajati zajedno s poštovanjem njihove slobode: kršćanin ne može prisiliti tuđu odluku, ali može nastaviti ljubiti, svjedočiti i moliti bez pretpostavke da je promjena nemoguća.

citations.document_title: Apostolic Journey to Jamaica, Mexico and Denver: Solemnity of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary - 8th World Youth Day in Denver (15 August 1993)

magisterium.assessment_en: The central message that Christ is light, that Mary in biblical imagery bears the reflection of that divine light, and that people freely respond to light or darkness is largely in accordance with Catholic understanding. Nevertheless, the claim that Revelation calls Jesus the "rising sun" is not supported by the cited biblical passage, and respect for the freedom of others should not mean abandoning prayer, love, conversation, and the call to conversion.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Gospel of John connects Christ with the light coming into the world, while the image of Mary clothed with the sun in Revelation can be interpreted in relation to divine light and the life that comes through her Son. The Catholic presentation of that image emphasizes Christ as the light of the world, and Mary as the one who is clothed with his divine light. Prayer for one's neighbors can stand together with respect for their freedom: a Christian cannot force another's decision, but can continue to love, witness, and pray without assuming that change is impossible.
concerns_en: Revelation describes a woman clothed with the sun; from this one cannot conclude without additional explanation that the book calls Jesus the "rising sun". It is necessary to distinguish the expression from biblical imagery and cite its other source if it is to be retained.

To accept that another person decides freely does not mean regarding every choice of theirs as morally good nor concluding that nothing more can be done. Such a formulation, if understood as giving up when there is no rapid change, can sound resigned.

sections.subtitle_en: The sun as an image of Christ and the gift of free will
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host speaks about the choice between light and darkness
sections.content_en:
Grebenar returns to an image that, as he says, he often repeats: **the sun is an image of God's light, and that light is Jesus Christ**. That is why Jesus is called the dawn from on high / dayspring, as is found in the Book of Revelation. From the same image he also interprets Our Lady "clothed with the sun": she carried in her womb Jesus, who is the light. He also recalls the prologue of John's Gospel: the light came into the world, but people preferred darkness to light because their deeds were evil.

From this he draws a lesson about **free will**. God gives man the freedom to choose for himself between light and darkness and what deeds he will do, and the believer must accept this. He illustrates this with experience from gatherings he leads. People, especially women, often approach him and complain that their son has taken the wrong path, that their daughter is living with a boyfriend, or that even worse things are happening in the family. They ask him what to do and how to make it stop.

His answer is twofold. On the one hand, one must pray and fast for the child, spouse, and other household members. On the other hand, if after some time there is no change, one must accept that it is a choice of that person's free will.

sections.subtitle: Kada molitva oslobađa, a kada valja čekati
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar razlikuje porobljenu osobu koja se opire grijehu od one koja je izabrala zlo
sections.content:
Grebenar zatim razlikuje dvije vrste situacija. Prva je kada je čovjek **porobljen, ali to ne želi i opire se**. Kao primjer navodi dijete začeto u preljubu ili na neki drugi nedoličan način. Duh pod kojim je začeto, tumači on, prati to dijete i kada odraste. Osoba tada griješi pod silom jačom od sebe same, primjerice uđe u odnos u koji ne bi smjela ući. Kada za to saznaju otac, majka, brat ili sestra, mogu je **postom i molitvom osloboditi**. Uvjet je da se i sama osoba tome opire. Tada su, kaže, molitve plodonosne.

Druga je situacija kada je netko **svjesno odlučio tako živjeti, brani to i ustraje u tome**. Tada ga, po Grebenarovim riječima, nitko ne može promijeniti. Članu obitelji preostaje prikazivati ga na misama i u molitvama, biti strpljiv i čekati.

Zaključuje da ukućani, braća, sestre i ostali imaju slobodnu volju i mogu izabrati tamu umjesto svjetla, a Bog ih u tome neće spriječiti. Bog Otac neće ni jednom čovjeku oduzeti dar slobodne volje. Ističe i da se u raj ne može ući niti se spasiti onaj tko srcem ne ljubi Boga i ne radi za kraljevstvo Božje. **Kršćanstvo, poručuje, nije religija sile**, nego objavljena istina u koju se vjeruje srcem i slobodnom voljom, i po tome se razlikuje od drugih religija.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno naglašava slobodu, molitvu i potrebu da se čovjek slobodno odazove Bogu, ali važna tvrdnja da način začeća uzrokuje trajnu duhovnu porobljenost nije potkrijepljena ponuđenim izvorima. Također pretjerano kategorički prikazuje mogućnost obraćenja osobe koja ustraje u grijehu: kršćanska sloboda ne isključuje djelovanje Božje milosti ni snagu molitve za drugoga.
concerns: Tvrdnja da duh povezan s preljubom ili drugim nedoličnim činom začeća prati dijete i kasnije uzrokuje grijeh nije utemeljena u ponuđenim izvorima; takva uzročna veza može pogrešno pripisati djetetu duhovnu posljedicu grijeha roditelja.
Post i molitva mogu biti oblici zagovora, ali odlomak ne bi smio predstavljati oslobođenje kao predvidljiv ishod pod određenim uvjetom, odnosno kao nešto što vrijedi samo ako se osoba sama opire.
Tvrdnja da osobu koja svjesno ustraje nitko ne može promijeniti zanemaruje da se Božja milost obraća slobodi i da je kršćanski život duhovna borba; sloboda ne znači da obraćenje više nije moguće.

Tvrdnja da se nitko ne može spasiti ako srcem ne ljubi Boga treba biti uravnotežena naukom da je spasenje dar milosti koji čovjek prihvaća vjerom, nadom i ljubavlju, a ne rezultat samostalnog ljudskog postignuća.
Opis kršćanstva kao religije koja nije prisilna može se prihvatiti, ali usporedba kojom se ono općenito razlikuje od drugih religija široka je tvrdnja koju ponuđeni izvori ne potkrepljuju.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički okvir drži zajedno Božju inicijativu i ljudsku slobodu: Krist oslobađa od ropstva grijeha, a čovjek tu milost prihvaća i surađuje s njom. Zato molitva za bližnjega ima smisla, dok se njezini plodovi ne mogu svesti na mehaničnu formulu niti se može isključiti mogućnost kasnijeg obraćenja.
