sections.subtitle: Hereze „gore od Arijeve“
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar govori o suvremenim herezama i uspoređuje ih s arijanizmom
sections.content:
Takav govor, objašnjava Grebenar, potreban je kako bi se spriječilo da se u narodu i Crkvi rađaju hereze. Ako se ne tvrdi da je Isus Krist Sin Božji i da nema spasenja osim po njemu, takvo je naviještanje evanđelja po njegovu sudu heretično, i to **gore od Arijeva**.

Podsjeća na Arija iz ranog kršćanstva, koji je naučavao da Isus nije od vječnosti, nego da ga je Bog stvorio kao stvorenje. Zbog toga je bio izopćen iz Crkve. Današnje pojave voditelj opisuje kao „hereze na entu potenciju“.

Zaključuje da kršćani danas trebaju **braniti Isusa Krista**, jer se tako brani i Crkva. Kritizira to što je, kako kaže, postalo važnije pojavljivati se na društvenim mrežama i u medijima, tumačiti hereze i pozivati narod na njih nego braniti Krista.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na Isusovu božanstvu i na spasenju po Kristu u skladu je s katoličkom vjerom; arijanizam je upravo poricao da je Sin pravi Bog, a Nicejski sabor ispovjedio je da je istobitan s Ocem. Ipak, tvrdnja da su neimenovane današnje pojave „gore od Arijeva“ ne može se teološki prosuditi bez njihova sadržaja, a takva usporedba može biti pretjerana ili neprecizna.
concerns: Izraz „hereze gore od Arijeve“ iznosi rangiranje bez obrazloženja i bez navođenja konkretnih nauka koji se uspoređuju.

Tvrdnja da je naviještanje heretično ako se izričito ne kaže da je Isus Sin Božji i da nema spasenja osim po njemu zahtijeva kontekst: izostanak neke formulacije u pojedinom govoru nije sam po sebi dokaz da govornik poriče tu istinu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva je odbacila Arijevo učenje da je Sin stvorenje i ispovjedila da je vječni Sin istobitan s Ocem; time je čuvala istinu o Isusovu božanstvu i njegovoj spasenjskoj ulozi. Kristovo spasenje nije ograničeno na jednu skupinu, nego je namijenjeno svim ljudima, pa obrana Kristova identiteta treba ići zajedno s vjernim i razumljivim naviještanjem njegova djela spasenja.
magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on Jesus' divinity and on salvation through Christ is in accordance with the Catholic faith; Arianism specifically denied that the Son is true God, and the Council of Nicaea confessed that he is consubstantial with the Father. However, the claim that unnamed present-day phenomena are „worse than Arius's” cannot be theologically judged without their content, and such a comparison may be exaggerated or imprecise.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church rejected Arius's teaching that the Son is a creature and confessed that the eternal Son is consubstantial with the Father; in doing so, it safeguarded the truth of Jesus' divinity and his salvific role. Christ's salvation is not limited to one group, but is intended for all people, so the defense of Christ's identity should go together with the faithful and intelligible proclamation of his work of salvation.
concerns_en: The phrase „heresies worse than Arius's” presents a ranking without substantiation and without citing the specific teachings being compared.

The claim that proclamation is heretical if it is not explicitly stated that Jesus is the Son of God and that there is no salvation except through him requires context: the omission of a particular formulation in an individual speech is not in itself proof that the speaker denies that truth.

sections.subtitle_en: Heresies „worse than Arius's“
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar speaks about contemporary heresies and compares them with Arianism
sections.content_en:
Such discourse, Grebenar explains, is necessary in order to prevent heresies from being born among the people and in the Church. If it is not asserted that Jesus Christ is the Son of God and that there is no salvation except through him, such proclamation of the Gospel is, in his judgment, heretical, and that **worse than Arius's**.

He recalls Arius from early Christianity, who taught that Jesus is not from eternity, but that God created him as a creature. Because of that, he was excommunicated from the Church. The host describes today's occurrences as "heresies to the nth power."

He concludes that Christians today need to **defend Jesus Christ**, because in that way the Church is defended as well. He criticizes the fact that, as he says, it has become more important to appear on social networks and in the media, interpreting heresies and calling the people to them, than to defend Christ.

sections.subtitle: Strah Božji u kostima i samo dvoja vrata vječnosti
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj priznaje da se boji za vlastito spasenje
sections.content:
U jednom od najosobnijih trenutaka emisije Vladimir Grebenar navodi riječi psalma: „Blago onome tko se boji Gospodina.“ Priznaje da se boji Gospodina i posljednjeg suda, toliko da mu je, kako kaže, strah Božji „u kostima“. Na tom daru zahvaljuje Bogu. Upravo mu taj strah, objašnjava, daje snagu da mu nije teško snimati, putovati, raditi i pozivati ljude na obraćenje.

Iskreno dodaje da se boji da se neće spasiti. Poziva se na svetog Pavla, koji je pisao da ne misli da je to već postigao. Ako tako govori apostol, pita se voditelj, što onda reći za sebe, kojega naziva „crvom običnim, nitko i ništa“. Čvrsto vjeruje da je ispravan pristup vjeri bojati se Boga i dobro paziti kako se svjedoči za Isusa.

Za kraj tumačenja vraća se zaključnoj rečenici evanđelja. Jedni odlaze u muku vječnu, odnosno u smrt i pakao, a pravednici koji su vršili volju Božju u život vječni. Na kraju postoje **samo dvoja vrata**. Čak će se i čistilište jednog dana zatvoriti, kad iz njega izađe posljednja duša. Kad prođe vrijeme, ostaju samo dvije stvarnosti: pakao, odnosno muka vječna, i život vječni.

Tumačenje završava porukom: „Pazimo dobro sada već na kojoj smo strani.“

magisterium.assessment: Poziv na strahopoštovanje prema Bogu, ozbiljno shvaćanje suda i obraćenje te tvrdnja da čistilište nije vječno u osnovi su usklađeni s katoličkim naukom. Potrebna je, međutim, nijansa: kršćanski strah ne bi smio postati očaj zbog vlastitog spasenja, a izraz „smrt i pakao“ može zamagliti razliku između vječne smrti kao konačne odvojenosti od Boga i tjelesne smrti.
concerns: Osobni strah da se neće spasiti može biti izraz poniznosti i ozbiljnog shvaćanja odgovornosti, ali ako vodi očaju ili zanemaruje Božje milosrđe, nije uravnotežen kršćanski stav.
Izjednačavanje „smrti“ i „pakla“ nije dovoljno precizno: katolički nauk govori o vječnoj kazni i konačnoj sudbini, dok se sama smrt u teološkom smislu može odnositi na različite stvarnosti.
Slika „samo dvoja vrata“ prikladna je za konačnu sudbinu nakon dovršenja čišćenja, ali ne bi trebala sugerirati da čistilište nije stvarno međustanje za one koji umru u Božjoj milosti.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička eshatologija uči da nakon smrti slijedi osobni sud te da duša može ući u nebo, biti očišćena u čistilištu ili ostati zauvijek isključena iz blaženog gledanja Boga; čistilište je privremeno i usmjereno prema nebu. Govor o posljednjem sudu treba zajedno čuvati ozbiljnost ljudske odgovornosti, nadu i pouzdanje u Krista: crkveno učenje ne umanjuje vječnu sudbinu, ali sud opisuje i kao razlog kršćanske nade i utjehe.
magisterium.assessment_en: The call to reverence toward God, taking judgment and conversion seriously, and the claim that purgatory is not eternal are fundamentally in alignment with Catholic teaching. A nuance is needed, however: Christian fear should not become despair over one's own salvation, and the phrase „death and hell” can blur the distinction between eternal death as definitive separation from God and bodily death.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic eschatology teaches that after death follows particular judgment and that a soul can enter heaven, be purified in purgatory, or remain forever excluded from the beatific vision of God; purgatory is temporary and directed toward heaven. Discourse about the Last Judgment should together safeguard the seriousness of human responsibility, hope, and trust in Christ: church teaching does not diminish eternal destiny, but describes judgment also as a reason for Christian hope and consolation.
concerns_en: Personal fear that one will not be saved can be an expression of humility and taking responsibility seriously, but if it leads to despair or neglects God's mercy, it is not a balanced Christian attitude.
Equating „death” and „hell” is not sufficiently precise: Catholic teaching speaks of eternal punishment and final destiny, while death itself in a theological sense can refer to different realities.

The image of „only two doors” is suitable for the final destiny after the completion of purification, but should not suggest that purgatory is not a real intermediate state for those who die in God's grace.

sections.subtitle_en: Fear of God in the bones and only two gates of eternity
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host admits that he fears for his own salvation
sections.content_en:
In one of the most personal moments of the show, Vladimir Grebenar quotes the words of the psalm: "Blessed is the one who fears the Lord." He admits that he fears the Lord and the final judgment, so much that, as he says, the fear of God is "in his bones." He thanks God for that gift. Precisely that fear, he explains, gives him strength so that it is not hard for him to record, travel, work, and call people to conversion.

He honestly adds that he fears he will not be saved. He refers to Saint Paul, who wrote that he does not think he has already attained it. If an apostle speaks that way, the host asks, what then to say for himself, whom he calls "an ordinary worm, a nobody and nothing." He firmly believes that the correct approach to faith is to fear God and pay close attention to how one witnesses for Jesus.

To conclude the interpretation, he returns to the concluding sentence of the Gospel. Some go into eternal punishment, that is, into death and hell, and the righteous who did the will of God into eternal life. In the end, there are **only two doors**. Even purgatory will one day be closed, when the last soul exits it. When time passes, only two realities remain: hell, that is, eternal punishment, and eternal life.

The interpretation ends with the message: "Let us pay close attention already now to which side we are on."

sections.subtitle: Turneja „Isus lider – treći dio“: od Biograda do Nove Gradiške
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar najavljuje raspored promocija knjige Isus lider, treći dio
sections.content:
Nakon tumačenja Grebenar najavljuje promocije knjige **„Isus lider“, treći dio**, s podnaslovom *„Kako spriječiti razorne demonske utjecaje“*. Svi skupovi imaju isti program:

1. molitva krunice od 19 sati,
2. predstavljanje knjige,
3. predstavljanje domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora.

Posjetitelje moli da dođu ranije kako bi stigao potpisati knjige onima koji ih kupe.

**Raspored:**
- **ponedjeljak, 2. studenoga**: Biograd na Moru, hotel Ilirija, Tina Ujevića 7
- **utorak, 3. studenoga**: Solin, hotel President Solin, Ivana Pavla II.
- **srijeda**: Imotski, Pučko otvoreno učilište Imotski, Ante Starčevića 7
- **utorak, 10. studenoga**: Valpovo, Vila Valpovo, bana Josipa Jelačića 1
- **srijeda**: Nova Gradiška, Centar kompetencija Nova Gradiška, Industrijska ulica 23/1

Voditelj najavljuje da će naknadno objaviti i termine za četvrtak i petak.

magisterium.assessment: Ovaj je odlomak uglavnom organizacijska najava, a ne sustavno izlaganje vjere; najava molitve krunice u skladu je s katoličkom marijanskom pobožnošću. Sam podnaslov knjige o demonskim utjecajima ne omogućuje procjenu njezina sadržaja ni načina na koji se u njoj tumači djelovanje zla.
concerns: Tema demonskih utjecaja zahtijeva razborito razlikovanje i ne bi se smjela koristiti za olako pripisivanje problema đavolskom djelovanju; iz ovog odlomka nije vidljivo čini li knjiga to.
magisterium.enrichment: Krunica može biti kršćanska molitva koja pomaže u unutarnjoj borbi i usmjerava vjernika na molitvu i pomoć drugima. Istodobno, Crkva traži razboritost i kritičku procjenu kada se govori o mogućem demonskom djelovanju, uz očuvanje odgovornosti i slobode čovjeka.

citations.document_author: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith

magisterium.assessment_en: This passage is mostly an organizational announcement, not a systematic exposition of faith; the announcement of praying the Rosary is in accordance with Catholic Marian devotion. The subtitle of the book alone concerning demonic influences does not make it possible to evaluate its content or the way in which the operation of evil is interpreted in it.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Rosary can be a Christian prayer that helps in inner struggle and directs the believer toward prayer and helping others. At the same time, the Church requires prudence and critical assessment when speaking about possible demonic activity, while preserving the responsibility and freedom of man.
concerns_en: The topic of demonic influences requires prudent discernment and should not be used for lightly attributing problems to the devil's activity; from this passage it is not evident whether the book does that.

sections.subtitle_en: Tour „Jesus the Leader – Part Three“: from Biograd to Nova Gradiška
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar announces the schedule of promotions for the book Jesus the Leader, Part Three
sections.content_en:
Following the interpretation, Grebenar announces the promotions of the book **"Jesus the Leader", Part Three**, subtitled *"How to Prevent Devastating Demonic Influences"*. All gatherings have the same program:

1. Rosary prayer starting at 7 p.m.,

He asks visitors to arrive earlier so that he has time to sign books for those who buy them.

sections.subtitle: Članstvo bez obveze plaćanja: odgovor kritičarima Ora et Labore
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj odbacuje optužbe da traži novac i objašnjava model članarine

magisterium.assessment: Poziv na dobrovoljni doprinos, volontiranje i sudjelovanje molitvom ili djelovanjem može biti usklađen s kršćanskim služenjem, a dobrovoljnost donacija iznesena je jasno. Ipak, nazivanje kritika „sotonskima” retorički je nepromišljeno: ne dokazuje da su kritičari pod demonskim utjecajem te može poticati nepravedno demoniziranje protivnika.
concerns: Pripisivanje kritika Sotoni bez razboritog utvrđivanja razloga ili činjenica nije primjeren način katoličkog razlučivanja; Crkva upozorava na olaku uporabu đavla kao objašnjenja i zahtijeva oprez.
Tvrdnje o postupanju s novcem, pravima članova i volonterskom radu nisu provjerljive teološkim sadržajem ovog odlomka, pa se ne mogu ovdje potvrditi kao činjenično ili pravno točne.
magisterium.enrichment: Nesebično služenje bez očekivanja nagrade može biti vrijedan oblik kršćanske ljubavi, a volonterski rad može pridonositi dostojanstvu i dobru drugih. Dobrovoljnost financijskog doprinosa i spremnost na služenje mogu biti pozitivni, ali kršćanski poziv na velikodušnost ne uklanja važnost razboritosti, istinoljubivosti i poštovanja prema onima koji postavljaju pitanja.

citations.document_author: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith

magisterium.assessment_en: The call for voluntary contributions, volunteering, and participating through prayer or action can be in alignment with Christian service, and the voluntary nature of donations is stated clearly. Nevertheless, calling criticisms „satanic” is rhetorically reckless: it does not prove that the critics are under demonic influence and it can encourage the unjust demonization of opponents.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Selfless service without expecting a reward can be a valuable form of Christian love, and volunteer work can contribute to the dignity and good of others. The voluntary nature of financial contribution and the readiness to serve can be positive, but the Christian call to generosity does not eliminate the importance of prudence, truthfulness, and respect toward those who ask questions.
concerns_en: Attributing criticisms to Satan without prudent determination of reasons or facts is not an appropriate way of Catholic discernment; the Church warns against the facile use of the devil as an explanation and requires caution.

Claims about the handling of money, the rights of members, and volunteer work are not verifiable by the theological content of this passage, so they cannot be confirmed here as factually or legally accurate.

sections.subtitle: Svjedočanstva Luce, Ivane i Branke: bez tableta, bez nesanice, bez polipa
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar čita pisana svjedočanstva slušateljica o ozdravljenjima i obraćenjima
sections.content:
Pred kraj emisije Vladimir Grebenar čita svjedočanstva slušateljica.

**Luca** piše da je uz Božju pomoć i ovaj podcast odbacila sve tablete za smirenje i protiv bolova, koje je prije pila svakodnevno. Od kolovoza prošle godine nije uzela nijednu i dobro se osjeća. Posti biblijski post srijedom i petkom uz sve svoje obveze. Iz njezine obitelji, kaže, nestaju psovke i sve ide na bolje.

**Ivana** svjedoči da ju je Gospodin ozdravio od nesanice i akni na licu dok je postila srijedom i petkom o kruhu i vodi. Dodaje da su joj se jetrve obratile i da im „nikad nije bilo ljepše“ nego sada, kad je Isus u njihovim životima.

**Branka** opisuje iskustvo izlječenja. Godine 2019. dijagnosticiran joj je polip na maternici, a stanje se godinama pratilo. Na preporuku liječnice 2025. otišla je na operaciju, no pri samom pregledu ustanovljeno je da polipa nema. Četiri do pet liječnika koji su ga dijagnosticirali navodno su u tih šest godina pogriješili. Branka izlječenje pripisuje molitvi molitvene zajednice „Dobri pastir“, kojoj pripada, i vlastitoj molitvi. Ora et Labora prati svakodnevno i moli Gospinu krunicu. Na podcast ju je uputila radna kolegica, za njezin rođendan u studenome prošle godine, što smatra jednim od najboljih poklona koje je dobila.

Grebenar zahvaljuje na svjedočanstvima i naglašava njihovu važnost. Kad netko posvjedoči što je Isus učinio u njegovu životu, drugi se obraćaju. Prenosi da to ističu i neki njegovi prijatelji svećenici. Podsjeća da Isus nije rekao „bit ćete mi dokazivači vjere“ ili „tumači mojih misli“, nego **„bit ćete mi svjedoci“**. Tek kad je netko Kristov svjedok, Bog mu daje milost da može tumačiti ono što mu je otkriveno.

magisterium.assessment: Svjedočenje o obraćenju, molitvi i Božjoj pomoći u načelu je u skladu s kršćanskim poslanjem svjedoka, a izraz „bit ćete mi svjedoci” odgovara Dj 1,8. Ipak, osobito kod prestanka uzimanja lijekova i pripisivanja nestanka polipa molitvi, potrebno je razlikovati osobno svjedočanstvo od utvrđenog medicinskog uzroka ili crkveno potvrđenog čuda.
concerns: Svjedočanstvo Luce o prestanku uzimanja tableta za smirenje i protiv bolova ne bi se smjelo shvatiti kao preporuka drugima da prekinu terapiju bez dogovora s liječnikom; Crkva cijeni molitvu, ali ne smatra se oslobođenom dužnosti skrbi i liječenja bolesnih.

Nestanak polipa može se vjerno ispričati kao osobno iskustvo i pripisati Božjoj providnosti, ali sam iskaz ne dokazuje da je riječ o čudesnom ozdravljenju niti utvrđuje medicinski uzrok; Crkva je, prema navedenom nauku, pri procjeni takvih ozdravljenja vrlo zahtjevna i oprezna.

Tvrdnju da Bog tek Kristovu svjedoku daje milost tumačenja objavljenoga treba nijansirati: kršćansko svjedočenje je važno, ali samo po sebi ne jamči ispravno teološko tumačenje; ono traži i primjerenu formaciju u vjeri te život usklađen s njom.
magisterium.enrichment: Apostolsko svjedočenje ima posebno mjesto jer su apostoli bili očevici Kristovih djela i izravni primatelji njegova nauka; današnje vjerničko svjedočenje sudjeluje u navještaju, ali nije istovjetno tom jedinstvenom apostolskom svjedočanstvu. Molitva i post mogu biti vrijedni izrazi obraćenja, no osobna svjedočanstva najbolje služe vjeri kad se iznose bez pretjeranih uzročnih zaključaka i uz poštovanje liječničke skrbi.
magisterium.assessment_en: Bearing witness to conversion, prayer, and God's help is in principle in accordance with the Christian mission of witnesses, and the phrase „you will be my witnesses” corresponds to Acts 1:8. However, especially regarding the discontinuation of medication and attributing the disappearance of polyps to prayer, it is necessary to distinguish personal testimony from an established medical cause or a Church-confirmed miracle.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Apostolic witness has a special place because the apostles were eyewitnesses of Christ's deeds and direct recipients of his teaching; today's witness of believers participates in proclamation, but is not identical to that unique apostolic witness. Prayer and fasting can be valuable expressions of conversion, but personal testimonies best serve the faith when presented without exaggerated causal conclusions and with respect for medical care.
concerns_en: Luca's testimony about stopping sedatives and painkillers should not be understood as a recommendation to others to discontinue therapy without consulting a doctor; the Church values prayer, but does not consider itself exempt from the duty of care and treatment of the sick.

The disappearance of polyps can be faithfully recounted as a personal experience and attributed to God's providence, but the statement alone does not prove that it is a miraculous healing nor does it establish a medical cause; according to the referenced teaching, the Church is very demanding and cautious in evaluating such healings.

The claim that only to Christ's witness does God give the grace of interpreting what has been revealed needs nuance: Christian witness is important, but does not in itself guarantee a correct theological interpretation; it also requires appropriate formation in the faith and a life in alignment with it.

sections.subtitle_en: Testimonies of Luca, Ivana, and Branka: no pills, no insomnia, no polyps
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar reads written testimonies of female listeners about healings and conversions
sections.content_en:
Toward the end of the show, Vladimir Grebenar reads testimonies from female listeners.

**Luca** writes that with God's help and this podcast, she discarded all sedatives and pain pills, which she previously took daily. Since August of last year, she has not taken a single one and feels good. She fasts the biblical fast on Wednesdays and Fridays alongside all her obligations. From her family, she says, cursing is disappearing and everything is getting better.

**Ivana** testifies that the Lord healed her of insomnia and facial acne while she fasted on Wednesdays and Fridays on bread and water. She adds that her sisters-in-law converted and that "it has never been better for them" than now, when Jesus is in their lives.

**Branka** describes an experience of healing. In 2019, she was diagnosed with a uterine polyp, and the condition was monitored for years. On the recommendation of her doctor, in 2025 she went for surgery, but during the examination itself, it was determined that there was no polyp. Four to five doctors who had diagnosed it supposedly made a mistake during those six years. Branka attributes the healing to the prayer of the prayer community "Dobri pastir", to which she belongs, and her own prayer. She follows Ora et Labora daily and prays Our Lady's Rosary. She was directed to the podcast by a female work colleague, for her birthday in November of last year, which she considers one of the best gifts she received.

Grebenar thanks for the testimonies and emphasizes their importance. When someone testifies to what Jesus did in their life, others convert. He conveys that some of his priest friends also emphasize this. He recalls that Jesus did not say "you will be my provers of faith" or "interpreters of my thoughts," but **"you will be my witnesses"**. Only when someone is a witness of Christ does God give him the grace to be able to interpret what has been revealed to him.

sections.subtitle: Muškarci na trgovima, završni blagoslov i centar Kraljica Mira
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj poziva na kupnju knjiga Isus lider za dovršetak edukacijskog centra Kraljica Mira u Međugorju
sections.content:
Grebenar najavljuje **molitvu krunice na hrvatskim trgovima** u Hrvatskoj i Bosni i Hercegovini u subotu, 7. studenoga, na prvu subotu u mjesecu. Okuplja ju inicijativa Hrvata izvan domovine, koja poziva muškarce da se organiziraju. Na ekranu su brojevi organizatora u Münchenu i Frankfurtu. Hrvate iz dijaspore poziva da dođu u domovinu, na glavni zagrebački trg, a slušatelje da pokrenu molitvu krunice na trgovima svojih mjesta. Ističe da snažno podržava to da muškarci mole krunicu.

Emisiju zatim zaključuje blagoslovom: „Neka se sveta Majka sa svojim Sinom i svetim Josipom udostoji blagoslov svoj nam dati.“

Na samom kraju upućuje molbu za potporu. Kupnjom prve, druge i treće knjige **„Isus lider“** pomaže se dovršetak **međunarodnog edukacijskog centra Kraljica Mira u Međugorju**. Objašnjava da mora završiti kupnju i opremanje centra, a prihod od knjiga neće biti dovoljan, pa će i sam morati uložiti privatni novac. Slušatelje potiče da kupuju knjige i daruju ih drugima. Knjiga, kaže, može godinama stajati u ormaru, ali kad je netko nakon nekoliko godina pročita i obrati se, „to se računa“. Sam projekt, naglašava, služi evangelizaciji i obraćenju drugih ljudi na slavu Božju.

Oproštaj je kratak: poziv da se Ora et Labora prati svaki dan i riječi „Neka je sve na veću slavu Božju“.

magisterium.assessment: Poziv na zajedničku molitvu krunice i evangelizaciju, kao i potpora projektu koji se predstavlja kao služenje evangelizaciji, u načelu su usklađeni s katoličkom pobožnošću i poslanjem Crkve. Završna formulacija o blagoslovu po svetoj Majci, njezinu Sinu i svetom Josipu može se razumjeti kao zaziv njihova zagovora, ali je dobro jasno čuvati da je Bog izvor blagoslova.
concerns: Izraz „neka se sveta Majka sa svojim Sinom i svetim Josipom udostoji blagoslov svoj nam dati” može biti pobožan zaziv zagovora, ali bez dodatnog objašnjenja mogao bi zvučati kao da Marija i Josip daju blagoslov neovisno o Bogu; katolički je prikladnije razumjeti njihov doprinos kao zagovor, dok blagoslov dolazi od Boga.

Iz opisa nije moguće procijeniti sadržaj knjiga, financijsku transparentnost prikupljanja sredstava ni konkretno djelovanje centra; zato se može ocijeniti samo navedena namjera potpore evangelizaciji, a ne projekt u cjelini.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva cijeni krunicu kao zajedničku pobožnost koja meditira Kristov život, smrt i uskrsnuće te teži uskladiti molitvu sa životom. Organiziranje molitve na javnim trgovima i osobit poziv muškarcima sami po sebi ne stvaraju teološki problem, dok god je riječ o slobodnom pozivu na molitvu, a ne o isključivanju drugih vjernika. U katoličkom razumijevanju blagoslov se traži od Boga, a Blažena Djevica i sveci mogu se zazivati kao zagovornici.

magisterium.assessment_en: The call to common prayer of the Rosary and to evangelization, as well as support for a project presented as service to evangelization, are in principle in alignment with Catholic devotion and the mission of the Church. The closing formulation concerning blessing through the Holy Mother, her Son, and Saint Joseph can be understood as an invocation of their intercession, but it is good to preserve clearly that God is the source of blessing.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church values the Rosary as a communal devotion that meditates on Christ's life, death, and resurrection and strives to conform prayer with life. Organizing prayer in public squares and a special call to men do not in themselves create a theological problem, as long as it is a free invitation to prayer and not an exclusion of other believers. In Catholic understanding, blessing is sought from God, and the Blessed Virgin and saints may be invoked as intercessors.
concerns_en: The expression „may the Holy Mother with her Son and Saint Joseph deign to grant us their blessing” can be a pious invocation of intercession, but without additional explanation it could sound as if Mary and Joseph grant blessing independently of God; it is Catholicly more appropriate to understand their contribution as intercession, while blessing comes from God.

From the description it is not possible to assess the content of the books, the financial transparency of the fundraising, or the concrete activities of the center; therefore, only the stated intention of supporting evangelization can be evaluated, not the project as a whole.

sections.subtitle_en: Men on the squares, final blessing, and the Queen of Peace center
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host invites the purchase of Jesus the Leader books for the completion of the Queen of Peace educational center in Međugorje
sections.content_en:
Grebenar announces **Rosary prayer on Croatian squares** in Croatia and Bosnia and Herzegovina on Saturday, November 7, on the first Saturday of the month. It is gathered by an initiative of Croats outside the homeland, which calls on men to organize. On the screen are the numbers of the organizers in Munich and Frankfurt. He invites Croats from the diaspora to come to the homeland, to the main Zagreb square, and listeners to initiate Rosary prayer on the squares of their own places. He emphasizes that he strongly supports men praying the Rosary.

He then concludes the broadcast with a blessing: "May the Holy Mother with her Son and Saint Joseph deign to give us their blessing."

At the very end, he makes a request for support. Buying the first, second, and third books of **"Jesus the Leader"** helps complete the **Queen of Peace International Educational Center in Međugorje**. He explains that he must finish purchasing and equipping the center, and the proceeds from the books will not be enough, so he will also have to invest personal money. He encourages listeners to buy the books and gift them to others. A book, he says, can sit in a closet for years, but when someone reads it after several years and converts, "that counts." The project itself, he emphasizes, serves evangelization and the conversion of other people to the glory of God.

The farewell is brief: an invitation to follow Ora et Labora every day and the words "May everything be to the greater glory of God."
